title: 'Skinwalker' sightings in Utah from 2010 detailed in new UFO Files
description: The latest batch of UFO Files released last week details investigations around a creature people claim to have seen on a ranch in Utah in 2010. While there is no proof of Skinwalkers, the files include a drawing and details of hair samples from the alleged creature.

title: Pentagon's UFO Files Open a Portal to the Unknown With Chilling Claims of Seven-Foot Skinwalkers
description: Newly released files from a Pentagon-linked investigation document witness claims of strange creatures, glowing objects and a possible portal near Utah's Skinwalker Ranch, but DNA evidence offered ordinary explanations.

title: Department of War Publishes Seventh Release of UAP Files
description: The Department of War has released the seventh set of declassified historical Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) files.

title: FBI Agents Witnessed Eerie Silent UFO Over 'National Security Site' In June
description: The object went from a hover to the speed of a military fighter jet in a matter of seconds.
